production_authenticity.current_state_evidence_rationale: The solver-facing work request states desired end-state lifecycle and safety requirements only; it does not assert a specific incident, failed deployment, customer impact, or inherited runtime event that would require fabricated logs or handoff evidence.

stateful_dataset_exemption.reason: The provider's durable operational reality is Terraform Core state plus local Linux filesystem, passwd/group, symlink, content and crontab objects. A 10,000–20,000-row business database would be unrelated filler and would not exercise provider lifecycle semantics. Production authenticity is instead carried by ten differentiated managed-resource lifecycles, persistent OS state, native drift observation, transactional failure/retry behavior, scoped deletion and deterministic Ansible process control.

material_changes: runtime authenticity now makes current-state evidence conditional on asserted current-state facts
strict non-data-backed systems may use an explicit controller-approved dataset exemption
complexity classification is owned by the private behavioral test map
